recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the renderer again emits duplicate binding links for bindingName/valueSet pairs.
issue_request: FHIR-13058 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 correction reporting that the Binding table for Questionnaire.subjectType rendered two binding links, one using the value set URL and one using the ResourceType name, and asked that only the named link be present.
initial_application: The Jira issue was auto-approved and a 2017 Jira comment says it was already fixed. No git commit mentioning FHIR-13058 was found in the FHIR source history, so the original application appears to have been a pre-existing renderer/tooling correction or an unkeyed historical source/build change rather than a current source defect.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Questionnaire.subjectType StructureDefinition source has a single required ResourceType binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/resource-types. Current build.fhir.org profile JSON and questionnaire binding table output show the binding once as Questionnaire.subjectType / ResourceType / Required / Concrete FHIR Resource Types. Zulip exact-key and Confluence Jira-reference searches found no issue-specific discussion; a related 2023 Zulip thread confirmed ResourceType is expected as the constrained code binding for Questionnaire.subjectType and did not conflict with the no-change conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the authoritative source already carries the intended binding metadata and the duplicate URL-plus-name rendering problem is not present on the current public build surface.
